boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase activities on the Gustavus campus and in nearby Saint Peter, verified through college and city sources.

cards.title: Walk Three Ecosystems
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum at Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.notes: Follow the marked trails through prairie, coniferous forest, and deciduous forest, staying on paths to protect habitat and research areas.
cards.short_summary: Take a daylight walk across more than 2.5 miles of free Arboretum trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus states that the Arboretum has over 2.5 miles of trails through three ecosystems, permits walking, and charges no admission fee.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to all during daylight hours year-round; remain on trails, lawns, or paved roads.

cards.title: Run the Arb Trails
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum at Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.notes: Build a trail loop through the three habitat areas, yield to walkers, and keep your pace controlled around other visitors.
cards.short_summary: Turn the Arboretum’s no-fee trail network into an outdoor running route.
cards.evidence_claim: The college explicitly lists running as an allowed use of the Arboretum trails and states that there is no admission fee.
cards.access_notes: Free during the Arboretum’s daylight hours; use established trails and share them responsibly.

cards.title: Pedal the Dirt Trails
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum at Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.notes: Bring a bicycle and ride only on dirt trails or paved drives, slowing for pedestrians and avoiding restricted off-trail areas.
cards.short_summary: Use your own bike for a free ride through the campus natural area.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus permits bicycles on the Arboretum’s paved drives and dirt trails, and access to the grounds has no admission fee.
cards.access_notes: No admission or required purchase; bring your own bicycle and visit during daylight hours.

cards.title: Trace the Labyrinth
cards.subtitle: West of the Melva Lind Interpretive Center
cards.notes: Walk the established labyrinth slowly as a shared reflective activity, then leave the surrounding plants and natural materials in place.
cards.short_summary: Follow the Arboretum’s named labyrinth for a quiet, admission-free pause.
cards.evidence_claim: The official visit page identifies a labyrinth in the open fields west of the Melva Lind Interpretive Center and states that the grounds have no admission fee.
cards.access_notes: Free and open during daylight hours; reach it from the established lawn and trail areas.

cards.title: Share a Quiet Reset
cards.subtitle: North of the Borgeson Family Cabin
cards.notes: Meet for a screen-free pause in the hardwood forest, keep voices low, and use the garden for mindfulness, reflection, or prayer.
cards.short_summary: Spend a calm interval together in the Arboretum’s designated meditation garden.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus identifies a meditation garden north of the Borgeson Family Cabin for mindfulness, reflection, and prayer; Arboretum admission is free.
cards.access_notes: No admission or purchase is required; visit during daylight and remain within permitted areas.

cards.title: Spot Birds and Wildlife
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum at Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.notes: Scan the prairie, gardens, and forest edges for birds and insects, observing quietly without feeding, collecting, or disturbing wildlife.
cards.short_summary: Compare wildlife sightings across the Arboretum’s varied habitats.
cards.evidence_claim: The college describes the free Arboretum as habitat for birds, insects, and wildlife among gardens, prairie, and forests.
cards.access_notes: The grounds are free and open to all during daylight hours; wildlife must not be disturbed.

cards.title: Claim a Sunny Meadow Break
cards.subtitle: The Arboretum at Gustavus Adolphus College
cards.notes: Choose an open lawn or meadow for conversation or reading, and pack out everything so the shared natural area stays undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: Settle into an open Arboretum meadow without paying admission or buying anything.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus specifically invites visitors to enjoy a sunny meadow and states that the Arboretum is free, open to all, and has no admission fee.
cards.access_notes: Free during daylight hours; use lawn areas, follow posted rules, and leave natural materials where found.

cards.title: Browse the Hillstrom Galleries
cards.subtitle: C. Charles Jackson Campus Center
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition together and compare details in the works; confirm the museum calendar before arriving between terms.
cards.short_summary: See rotating and collection-based art in Gustavus’s free campus museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus states that admission to the Hillstrom Museum of Art, including receptions and special events, is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Hillstrom Museum Opens Season with Pull Left–Not Always Right
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; hours and exhibition availability vary, especially between exhibitions and when classes are not in session.

cards.entity_name: Saint Peter Community Center Walking Track
cards.title: Walk Indoor Laps
cards.subtitle: Saint Peter Community Center
cards.notes: Bring clean walking shoes and set a shared lap goal; strollers, walkers, and wheelchairs are also welcomed on the indoor track.
cards.short_summary: Use the city’s indoor track for a weather-proof, no-fee walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Peter’s 2026 community brochure says the Community Center walking track is free and open to anyone during regular business hours.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to anyone during regular Community Center business hours; clean walking shoes are required.

cards.title: Join a Free Library Program
cards.subtitle: Saint Peter Public Library
cards.notes: Check the library calendar, choose an age-appropriate author visit, music event, or special activity, and arrive before the posted start.
cards.short_summary: Meet at a scheduled public-library activity with no program charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Saint Peter Public Library’s 2026 board materials list author visits, special events, music, reading programs, and other activities and state that all library programs are free.
cards.access_notes: Library programs are free; consult the current calendar because dates, audience ages, and registration requirements vary.
